Metadata.title: BAHITH | باحث
Metadata.description: An Arabic-first academic research platform: from research question to export, with every claim tied to evidence.

Home.name: BAHITH
Home.tagline: Your methodical assistant for academic research, from research question to export.
Home.principle: Every claim is linked to verifiable evidence (source, page and passage), or explicitly labelled as an inference, a hypothesis or unsupported.
Home.workflowTitle: From a question to traceable evidence
Home.privacyDescription: Accounts and permissions separate project data and control access.
Home.reviewDescription: Claim candidates and quotation matches need your review. Finding a quotation does not establish a claim’s truth.
Home.traceDescription: File versions, passage locations and available page numbers are preserved so you can review quotations in context.
